title: PlanAndPayResult
description: Strict output of the make-plan Grok call. The make-plan function injects the live catalog ids as an enum on plans[].items[].catalog_id at runtime and strips $schema/$id before sending. Money is always integer USD cents.

members.description: One entry per group member mentioned in the chat or present in the roster.

member_id.description: Roster id if the person matches a roster entry, else null.

budget_cap_cents.description: Max this person will spend per person, in USD cents. Null if never stated.

dietary.description: e.g. vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, no pork. Empty if none.

availability.description: Free text window, e.g. 'Sat after 2pm'. Empty string if unknown.

location.description: Neighborhood/area they start from. Empty string if unknown.

constraints.description: Group-level constraints derived from all members.

max_per_person_cents.description: The LOWEST known member cap (the binding constraint). Null if no caps known.

needs_transit.description: True if any member has no car.

time_window.description: Overlap of everyone's availability. Empty string if unknown.

catalog_id.description: MUST be an id from the provided catalog (enum injected at runtime).

per_person_cents.description: Sum of items' price_per_person_cents from the catalog.

fits_everyone.description: True only if per_person_cents <= every known member cap AND dietary/transit/availability constraints are satisfied.

over_cap_member_names.description: Members whose cap is exceeded. Must be empty unless the plan is explicitly flagged (fits_everyone=false).

note.description: Why this plan works (or doesn't) for this person.

why_it_works.description: Short 'why it works for everyone' pitch shown to the group.

reasoning.description: Brief, user-facing explanation of trade-offs. No hidden chain-of-thought needed.
